question: The value of (0.3)[{⁽²⁰⁰ ⁻ ¹⁴⁶⁾/⁽³ × ³ × ³⁾} ⁻ ³] is:
solution:
**Given:**

(0.3)[{⁽²⁰⁰ ⁻ ¹⁴⁶⁾ / ⁽³ × ³ × ³⁾} ⁻ ³]

**Formula used:**

a⁻ⁿ = dfrac{1}{a^n}

**Calculations:**

(0.3)[{⁽²⁰⁰ ⁻ ¹⁴⁶⁾ / ⁽²⁷⁾} ⁻ ³]

⇒ (0.3)[⁵⁴ / ²⁷ ⁻ ³]

⇒ (0.3)[² ⁻ ³]

⇒ (0.3)⁻¹

⇒ (dfrac{3}{10})⁻¹

⇒ dfrac{10}{3}

**∴ The correct answer is option (1).**
